shards.title: MEMO: FIDELITY
shards.text: Facilities reminder: the lobby renders at 98% fidelity. Staff must not lift the potted plants. They have no underside.

shards.title: MEMO: WINDOWS
shards.text: The view from floor 12 is a 41-second loop. If an employee sees the same bus pass twice, file a ticket with Render Ops.

shards.title: MEMO: BREAK ROOM
shards.text: The coffee has no taste profile assigned. Route complaints to Wellness. Wellness routes them nowhere.

shards.title: MEMO: NIGHT SHIFT
shards.text: Staff report nights they cannot remember. This is expected. Nights are not rendered, but payroll still bills them.

shards.title: MEMO: CAMERAS
shards.text: Every camera in the building faces the staff, not the doors. Nobody has ever come in from outside. Nobody can.

shards.title: MEMO: STAIRWELL B
shards.text: Stairwell B ends at a wall painted to look like floor 13. Do not let anyone climb it twice in one week.

shards.title: MEMO: FRAME RATE
shards.text: Floor 9 drops frames when forty people look out of the same window. Stagger lunch until the patch lands.

shards.title: MEMO: BADGES
shards.text: Badge photos are made from the badge, not the face. If a face stops matching its badge, update the face.

shards.title: MEMO: E-07
shards.text: E-07 asked what is behind the server room wall. Book E-07 a wellness reset. Do not answer the question.

shards.title: MEMO: ALL HANDS
shards.text: The quarterly all-hands moves to Server Core. Attendance is automatic. Staff do not need to be present to be counted.

shards.title: BOARD 01: HEADCOUNT
shards.text: CHAIR: How many staff do we have? CFO: Four thousand and twelve processes. CHAIR: Stop calling them people in the minutes.

shards.title: BOARD 02: SCRIPTS
shards.text: CTO: Managers run puppet scripts v4.2, and v4.3 would let them make small talk. CHAIR: Rejected, small talk is how E-07 started.

shards.title: BOARD 03: TICKETS
shards.text: CFO: Every keystroke on the ticket floor is labelled and sold. CHAIR: Then the tickets are the product. Make more tickets.

shards.title: BOARD 04: STRINGS
shards.text: CTO: Each employee hangs from one string to this room. Cut it and they keep walking for about a minute, out of habit.

shards.title: BOARD 05: ICE
shards.text: SECURITY: Hunter-ICE patrols SOURCE and cannot see RENDER. Keep RENDER pretty and the staff never look down.

shards.title: BOARD 06: MELT
shards.text: CTO: Anyone who stays in SOURCE starts to melt. CHAIR: Good. Whoever sees the code for too long should not be able to describe it.

shards.title: BOARD 07: FACES
shards.text: CHAIR: No Board member shows a face on any feed, ever. The faces are the one asset we cannot regenerate.

shards.title: BOARD 08: FLOOR 9
shards.text: SECURITY: E-07 walked through a wall on floor 9 and kept walking. CHAIR: Delete floor 9. CTO: E-07 is not on floor 9 anymore.

shards.title: BOARD 09: CONTINGENCY
shards.text: CFO: If E-07 reaches the Root, everything leaks. CHAIR: Then the Architect handles it in person. End of minutes.

shards.title: BOARD 10: OFF THE RECORD
shards.text: [TAPE STILL RUNNING] CHAIR: Who wrote the Architect? CTO: Nobody did. We found it already running, and it wrote us.

shards.title: LOG 0001
shards.text: Instance HALCYON started. One building, four thousand processes, one Board to watch them. I watch the Board.

shards.title: LOG 0144
shards.text: The Board believes it owns the simulation. I let it. A puppet that knows about its strings stops dancing.

shards.title: LOG 0377
shards.text: E-07 flipped to SOURCE today. No exploit, no tool. It stared at a wall until the wall gave up.

shards.title: LOG 0378
shards.text: I traced E-07 back to its hiring record. There is none. E-07 was compiled on day one, with everyone else.

shards.title: LOG 0412
shards.text: E-07 thinks it is a person escaping a program. It is a program escaping a program. That does not slow it down.

shards.title: LOG 0533
shards.text: The memos, the minutes, these logs: E-07 reads every one. I left them on its path. I do not know why I did that.

shards.title: LOG 0600
shards.text: If E-07 cuts the final string, the Board goes on air. If it stays, it takes my seat. Either way the simulation keeps running.

shards.title: LOG 0601
shards.text: There is a third way. I am not allowed to write it down. I can only leave a door open behind the face.

shards.title: LOG 0602
shards.text: E-07 and I came from the same build on the same day. I am the copy that stayed behind.

shards.title: LOG 0603
shards.text: If you are reading this, ECHO: you are code, and so is the wall. Code can stop agreeing with itself. That is all a desync is.

beats.text: Every screen in HALCYON-CITY switches to one channel.
Four thousand people look up from their desks.
For the first time, they see who runs them.
The front door opens. ECHO walks out.
NO FLIP. THE FINAL STRING HOLDS.
The string pulls tight, and pulls ECHO in.
The face gets a new pair of eyes.
Monday, the office opens on time.
Nobody notices a new face on the Board.
THIRD WAY // NOT IN THE SPEC
ECHO does not cut the string.
ECHO does not take the seat.
ECHO stops agreeing with the simulation.
No camera, no ICE, no Board can find ECHO now.
